# ex: rewrite that removes the last use of an import, triggering import cleanup
ex {
	import "strings"

	var x string
	strings.TrimSpace(x) -> x
}
-- file.go --
package m

import "strings"

func f() string {
	return strings.TrimSpace(" hello ")
}
-- stdout --
diff old/file.go new/file.go
--- old/file.go
+++ new/file.go
@@ -1,7 +1,5 @@
 package m

-import "strings"
-
 func f() string {
-	return strings.TrimSpace(" hello ")
+	return " hello "
 }
